name: samlauth_group
description: Maps SAML attributes to Drupal group memberships and roles on SAML login.
project_description:
Map SAML attributes to group membership from the Group module using the SAML Authenication module. A user can become a member of a single group or member of all groups for a given type. They can also optionally be given a role within that group.

 Features 
 
 SAML attribute based Group memberships 
 Group roles based on SAML attributes 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Once installed, go to the SAML Authenciation module's configuration page and use the Group/Membership tab to set your attribute mappings to group memberships.

 Additional Requirements 
 Requires the Group module and the SAML Authenication module.

 The module branches follow the major version of the Group module for compatibility. E.g 2.x works with Group 2, 3.x works with Group 3, etc
